product_name: IKALL I6 Feature Keypad Mobile Phone – 2.4" Screen, 2500mAh Battery, FM Radio, Music & Video Player, Type-C Charging, Triple-Sim (Dodger Blue)
description: ✔ 2.4" Display – Enjoy vibrant and clear visuals on the compact screen, perfect for reading messages, viewing photos, and more. ✔ 2500mAh Battery – Stay powered longer with up to 5 days of standby time and 8 hours of talk time. Say goodbye to frequent charging and stay connected throughout the day. ✔ Multimedia Entertainment – Experience entertainment wherever you go with the built-in Music Player, Video Player, and FM Radio. Play your favorite tunes or listen to live radio broadcasts at your convenience. ✔ Type-C Charging & 3.5mm Jack – Charge your phone quickly with the modern Type-C charger. Plus, enjoy high-quality sound by connecting your headphones or speakers through the 3.5mm audio jack. ✔ Reliable Warranty – Enjoy peace of mind with a 1-year warranty for the device and 6 months for accessories, ensuring durability and support with your purchase.
